noun_definition: iOS refers to the operating system used on Apple mobile devices, in which the New Expensify app is being tested for functionality related to expense reports.
Expense refers to a submitted financial record within the Expensify app that can be previewed in a direct message.
Chat header refers to the section of the expense report that is expected to display immediately upon opening the expense preview in the New Expensify app.
Delay refers to the lag in time before the expense report header appears after tapping on the expense preview in the app.
Expense report refers to the section of the app that displays details about submitted expenses, which is expected to appear instantly when accessing it from a direct message.
